PLAIN_LANGUAGE.LABEL: Plain-language tips
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.INTRO: Plain language (B1): tips only, nothing is blocked.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.LONG_SENTENCE: This sentence has {{words}} words. Keep it to {{limit}} or fewer: split it in two.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.PASSIVE_NL: “{{match}}” is passive. Say who does it, e.g. “we sturen u” instead of “u wordt gestuurd”.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.PASSIVE_EN: “{{match}}” is passive. Say who does it, e.g. “we will send” instead of “will be sent”.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.AND_OR: “{{match}}” asks two things at once. Ask one thing per question.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.TWO_QUESTIONS: This asks two questions. Make it two separate questions.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.JOINED_QUESTIONS: “{{match}} …” starts a second question. Ask it separately.

FORM_LANGUAGE.TITLE: Language
FORM_LANGUAGE.LABEL: Form language
FORM_LANGUAGE.HINT: The language the questions are written in. It tells screen readers and browsers which language to read them in.

PDF_IMPORT.WAITING_FOR_READER: Waiting for the document reader to become available. The import continues by itself.
PDF_IMPORT.DRAFT_REMOVED: Nothing was added to your forms list: the empty draft form was removed.
PDF_IMPORT.DRAFT_KEPT: Your draft form was kept because it already had changes.

encrypted.MESSAGE: This PDF is protected with a password.
encrypted.NEXT: Remove the password (for example by printing it to a new PDF) and upload it again.

unreadable.MESSAGE: This file could not be read. It may be damaged or not a real PDF or image.
unreadable.NEXT: Open it on your computer and save or print it to a new PDF, then upload that. Or try another file.

too_many_pages.MESSAGE: This document has more pages than one import can take.
too_many_pages.NEXT: Split it into smaller parts, for example one per section, and import each part.

too_large.MESSAGE: This file is too large to import.
too_large.NEXT: Upload a smaller file: reduce the image size, or split the document into parts.

too_complex.MESSAGE: This document holds more content than a form import can handle.
too_complex.NEXT: Try a simpler version, or split the document and import the parts one by one.

timeout.MESSAGE: Reading this document took too long.
timeout.NEXT: Try again. If it happens again, split the document into smaller parts or try another file.

empty.MESSAGE: This file has no pages or no content.
empty.NEXT: Check that you chose the right file and try another one.

unsupported_type.MESSAGE: This kind of file cannot be imported.
unsupported_type.NEXT: Upload a PDF, or a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo of the form.

no_questions.MESSAGE: No questions were found in this document.
no_questions.NEXT: Try a clearer scan or photo, or a PDF in which you can select the text. You can also build the form yourself.
no_questions.NEXT_WITHOUT_AI: Only the built-in reader was used, and it cannot read scans or photos. Upload a PDF in which you can select the text, or allow AI reading for this upload if your workspace uses AI.

unavailable.MESSAGE: The document reader is not available right now.
unavailable.NEXT: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, contact support.

failed.MESSAGE: Something went wrong while importing this document.
failed.NEXT: Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support.

START_ERROR.import_in_progress: Another import is still running in this workspace. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
START_ERROR.daily_limit: This workspace has reached its number of imports for the last 24 hours. Try again later.
START_ERROR.too_large: This file is too large to import. Upload a smaller file or split the document.
START_ERROR.unsupported_type: Choose a PDF, or a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo of a form.
START_ERROR.empty: This file is empty. Choose another file.
START_ERROR.upload_failed: The upload failed. Please try again.

THEME.HEADING: Type and shape
THEME.DATA_FONT_HINT: The submission number and other values respondents may copy or read back.
THEME.WIDE_TITLES_HINT: Sets titles a quarter wider, in Archivo's wide cut.
THEME.RADIUS_HINT: Of fields, answer options and buttons.
THEME.BUTTONS_HINT_OUTLINED: The button's edge and text take a colour that reads on the page.
THEME.HIGHLIGHT_HINT: The chosen answer and the notes beside a question. Where it is too light to read on the page, the text colour is used.
THEME.SELECTION_HINT: The chosen answer only; the highlight keeps the notes. Where it is too light to read on the page, the text colour is used.
THEME.SELECTION_NONE: Uses the highlight, else the button colour.
